old: Sabiendo que quiero ser periodista y trabajar en el extranjero, hablar otro idioma será fundamental.
new: Sabiendo que quiero ser periodista y trabajar en el extranjero, estoy convencido de que hablar otro idioma será fundamental.

old: Knowing that I want to be a journalist and work abroad, speaking another language will be essential.
new: Knowing that I want to be a journalist and work abroad, I am convinced that speaking another language will be essential.
reason: Match corrected Spanish (and fixes dangling modifier)

old: Sabiendo que paso casi todo el año lejos de mi familia, mis amigos del internado son muy importantes para mí.
new: Sabiendo que paso casi todo el año lejos de mi familia, valoro muchísimo a mis amigos del internado.
reason: Dangling gerund: "Sabiendo" needs the same subject (yo) as the main clause

old: Knowing that I spend almost all year far from my family, my friends in the boarding house are very important to me.
new: Knowing that I spend almost all year far from my family, I really value my friends at boarding school.
reason: Match corrected Spanish

old: the teacher tells the battles as if they were films
new: the teacher describes the battles as if they were films
reason: Unnatural English ("tells the battles")

old: and I tried to speak only in Spanish, and it was really funny!
new: and I tried to speak only in Spanish, and it was great fun!

old: Yesterday morning I had a Spanish lesson, as every Thursday.
new: Yesterday morning I had a Spanish lesson, as I do every Thursday.

old: because the train went along the sea.
